poe-murders-rue-morgue.description: A man in a dark frock coat, hair swept back, leans over a window sill in a dim, shabby room, holding a candle in a brass holder while his other hand works at the window latch. On the floor are an overturned wooden chair, scattered silver coins and torn paper scraps. Tall panelled doors and heavy curtains frame the room, and the painting fills the whole image edge to edge, with no text or border.

collins-woman-in-white.description: A woman in a long white gown with flowing sleeves reaches out one hand on a moonlit dirt path at night. A man in a top hat and dark frock coat, holding a book and a cane, stops and looks at her. A dark house sits in the background among trees under a cloudy sky with a bright moon. The style is a dark, painterly oil look with no visible text or frame.

collins-the-moonstone.description: A glowing amber-gold gem sits in an open wooden chest-of-drawers drawer, lit by a candle on the dresser. Beside it are a mirror, a glass bottle and a bowl. Behind, a dark bed with pillows and a curtain, with a shadowy figure's arm reaching across the bedcover on the right. The style is a dark oil painting. The scene is a shadowed bedroom with 19th-century furniture. No visible text, frame or border.

doyle-study-in-scarlet-holmes.description: A tall, gaunt man in a dark quilted dressing gown stands at a cluttered wooden table of glass flasks, retorts and test tubes, holding a test tube over a candle flame. Behind him a seated man in a waistcoat sits by a fireplace in a dim, wallpapered room with papers pinned to the wall and a pipe on the mantel. The style is a dark, painterly oil look with warm candlelight and no visible lettering or frame.

doyle-hound-of-the-baskervilles.description: A huge black shaggy hound with glowing orange eyes and open jaws bounds across a misty, rocky moor under a stormy sky. In the background stands a lit, gabled stone manor, and a small figure in a dark coat runs across the heath below it. The scene is a painted, dark, moody landscape with no visible text or frame.

leroux-mystery-of-the-yellow-room.description: A man in a flat cap and long dark coat kneels at a heavy studded wooden door in a stone corridor. He holds a lit lantern in one hand and reaches to the iron lock with the other. A small barred window sits high in the door, and a stone archway and steps are visible on the right. The lighting is warm and dim, in an oil-painting style.

chesterton-father-brown-debut.description: A stocky man in a black clerical coat and round black hat stands on a dim heath at dusk, carrying a brown paper parcel under one arm and a furled dark umbrella in the other hand. Behind him, far off to the left, a tall dark silhouette in a long coat and hat stands among low scrub under a smoky orange-and-grey sky. The painting is a dark, painterly oil style, filling the whole frame with no border.

christie-poirot-debut-styles.description: A mustached man in a dark three-piece suit with bow tie and watch chain bends over a bedside table in a four-poster bedroom, studying a teacup with a magnifying glass. A lit candle in a brass holder, a small medicine bottle, a book and small objects sit on the table, with a small dark red spill beside the saucer. Oil-painting style, edge to edge, no text, no border.

dickens-bleak-house-inspector-bucket.description: A man in a long dark overcoat and bowler hat stands on a cobbled street beside an arched wooden door with a brass plate and knocker. He raises one index finger and looks toward the viewer. A lit lantern sits on the cobbles at his feet, and a gas lamp glows through fog on the right. The palette is warm brown and amber, in painterly oil style.

holmes-strand-scandal-in-bohemia.description: A dark oil-style painting of a gaunt man in a caped dark overcoat, in profile, holding a small framed photograph of a woman. Behind him a masked figure in a fur-collared coat stands by a high-backed armchair. The room is cluttered Victorian with shelves of bric-a-brac, framed pictures, patterned wallpaper, a fireplace with a fire, and drifting smoke. No visible text, and the painting fills the image edge to edge.

sayers-lord-peter-wimsey-debut.description: A man in a black tailcoat, white waistcoat and black bow tie leans over a white clawfoot bathtub, looking down at a pair of pince-nez on the rim. He wears a monocle on a dark ribbon. Behind him are dark damask wallpaper, a grey subway-tile wall, brass pipes and a faucet, and a lit gas-style lamp on the right. The style is a dark, loose oil painting. The image fills the frame edge to edge, with no text except a tiny mark in the bottom-right corner.

christie-murder-of-roger-ackroyd.description: A dark, richly furnished wood-panelled study. A high-backed leather wingback chair stands turned away from a mahogany desk, with its back to the viewer. A brass-fitted cylinder recording device sits on a small side table by a tall window with a heavy curtain. Papers lie on a patterned red rug, and a framed portrait hangs in the upper left. No people or text are visible.

hammett-the-maltese-falcon.description: A glossy black bird statuette stands on a desk beside a lit green-shaded banker's lamp. A man in a fedora and trench coat stands in the dim background, with cigarette smoke curling up and venetian-blind shadows across the wall. A black rotary telephone and an ashtray sit at right, and papers lie on the left. The scene is an oil-painting style, filling the frame edge to edge with no border.

christie-murder-on-the-orient-express-no.description: A dark steam locomotive with a snow-covered dark blue carriage runs through a snowy mountain pass at night. Thick smoke rises from the funnel into a dark sky, and one carriage window glows warm amber. Pine forest and rocky peaks frame the scene, with deep snowdrifts in the foreground. The painting is loose, thick oil brushwork with no visible text, border or frame.

chandler-the-big-sleep-marlowe.description: A painted glasshouse full of orchids and hanging baskets under a slanted glass roof, with mist drifting through. On the left an elderly man with white hair sits in a wheelchair wrapped in a plaid blanket. On the right a man in a dark fedora and long trench coat stands with his back partly turned, looking toward the old man. No visible text, border or frame; the painting fills the canvas edge to edge.

spillane-mike-hammer-i-the-jury.description: A man in a tan trench coat and fedora stands in a dim interior, a revolver held loosely at his side, looking off with a hard expression. Behind him a window shows a night city of glowing lights, and a smoky hallway recedes to the right. Painterly, loose brushwork, no visible text or frame.

macdonald-lew-archer-moving-target.description: A man in a fedora and dark trench coat stands on a dirt shoulder at a cliff edge, looking up. Beside him is a dark 1940s sedan on a winding coastal road with a guardrail. Above, a white Spanish-style mansion with a red tile roof sits on a hillside among palms, with the ocean and surf to the right. The painting is an oil-style scene with warm, hazy light and no visible text or frame.

highsmith-talented-mr-ripley.description: A dark-haired man in a rolled white shirt and dark trousers stands in a wooden rowboat with an outboard motor, gripping an oar in both hands on deep blue choppy water. Behind him a hillside of white Mediterranean houses climbs above an arched stone wall, with steep cliffs and a small tower on the shore. Painterly, loose brushwork. No visible text, border or frame.

james-dalgliesh-cover-her-face.description: A man in a long dark overcoat stands in an open doorway holding a grey felt hat, looking into a dim room. A bed with an iron frame sits at left, and a lamp with a steaming mug and a closed book sit on a wooden nightstand. The wallpaper is patterned and the lighting is warm and low.

dexter-inspector-morse-debut.description: A black vintage saloon car, with a chrome grille and bumper, sits on a wet cobbled street at dusk. Behind it are grey stone buildings with a gothic spire, a domed rotunda and lit lamp posts. On the right, a pub doorway glows warm, and a small hanging sign has no legible text. The scene is painted in a moody, textured oil style, and there are no people.

eco-the-name-of-the-rose.description: An oil-style painting of a hooded, bearded monk in a brown habit holding a lit lantern up in a vaulted stone library, with rows of old books chained to the shelves on both sides. Stone staircases climb through the arches behind him. A young boy in a dark hooded habit stands at his right shoulder, looking alarmed. No text or frame is visible.

grafton-a-is-for-alibi.description: An oil-painted night scene of a cluttered wooden desk in a dim room. An open metal index-card box sits on the left, a black manual typewriter with a sheet in it sits center, and a black rotary telephone is at right. A revolver, a coffee mug, loose papers and an ashtray lie on the desk. Through a window with venetian blinds, palm trees and street lamps line a dark beach road, with the sea beyond. No people are visible.

cornwell-scarpetta-postmortem.description: A dark, moody laboratory interior painted in oil-like brushwork. A compound microscope with two eyepieces sits on a long steel bench, lit by a thin rainbow-tinted light beam. A white lab coat hangs on a hook at left, and a window with a dim view is behind. Glass flasks, test tubes, specimen jars and a small instrument sit on the bench and on shelves to the right, with papers at the left edge. No people, no text or labels visible, and the painting fills the whole frame.

tartt-the-secret-history.description: Four men in dark wool overcoats and one in a brown coat with a scarf stand in a snowy birch wood, looking down into a ravine. One young man crouches at the edge reaching toward the snow. A dark hardbound book lies in the snow in the foreground. Overcast grey sky, painterly brushwork, no visible text.

mccall-smith-no1-ladies-detective-agency.description: A single-storey blue-washed building with a corrugated metal roof and a open veranda sits under a large bare acacia tree at dusk. A small white van is parked to the left under the branches, and a wooden table on the veranda holds a teapot and cups. Dry red earth in the foreground, with a rocky mountain behind. No people, no visible text.

brown-the-da-vinci-code.description: A glass pyramid with a lit interior rises in the middle of a stone courtyard at night, flanked by classical stone building wings with lit windows. The pavement is wet and reflects the lights, and the sky is dark and stormy. There are no people, no visible text, and no frame. The style is a painterly, dark-toned digital painting.

larsson-girl-with-the-dragon-tattoo.description: A dim wooden room at night. A glowing open laptop sits on a rough wooden desk beside stacks and scattered piles of black-and-white photographs, an ashtray with cigarette butts and a mug of coffee. Through a window, two motorcycles stand in snow under a pale moon, and a fireplace glows at the right edge. No people and no visible text.

flynn-gone-girl.description: A dim, upscale living room in oil-paint style. A glass coffee table is shattered with shards across a dark patterned rug, an ottoman is overturned, and a cream envelope with tiny illegible cursive lies on the rug. Tall windows show bare trees and water at dusk, with a modern kitchen behind. The painting fills the frame with no border and no blood.

galbraith-cormoran-strike-debut.description: A snowy night street lined with cream Georgian-style town houses, a glowing black lamppost, modern parked cars dusted with snow, and red-and-white cordon tape strung along black iron railings. A balcony high on the facade has a dark tangle of ironwork or foliage on it. No people, no frame, no legible text, nothing gory.

osman-thursday-murder-club.description: A dim, cozy sitting room with four wingback armchairs around a low square table. A rain-streaked window with a lit table lamp sits behind them. The table holds a teapot, cups, a half-finished jigsaw puzzle and a stack of envelopes. No people, no visible text, and no frame or wall edge.
